## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 121 captures during January 2021. Activity was completed in line with the planned service arrangements. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No operational issues affecting the reported activity were identified.

The activity total provides the number of images captured at the site during the month. It is reported separately from image quality and grading outcomes to support routine monitoring of service delivery.

## Image quality

There were 2 ungradable images. The ungradable rate was 1.7 per cent of captures. This result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment. Image quality should continue to be monitored through routine review, with attention given to any recurring issues that may affect the ability to grade images.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. This indicates that grading was generally completed promptly during January 2021. The referable results should continue through the appropriate follow-up pathway in accordance with local arrangements. Overall, the reported activity, image quality and grading measures provide a summary of East City Eye Clinic’s performance for the month.
